test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. A big fancy dress ball was arranged to celebrate their homecoming.

B. It must have been a terrible shock for a young girl.

C. They had been married a month, just home from their honeymoon.

D. Just as the guests were starting to arrive, Charnley locked himself into his bedroom and shot himself.
solution:
The correct answer is '**BCAD**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence B sets the context by indicating that something shocking happened to a young girl.
 
• Sentence C provides background information about the couple and their honeymoon, leading up to the event.
 
• Sentence A mentions the celebration arranged for their homecoming, indicating a happy occasion.
 
• Sentence D reveals the tragic event that occurred during the celebration, completing the narrative.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**BCAD**'.
